references.text: Samson's father-in-law explains that he gave his daughter to Samson's friend, the same friend mentioned in 14:20
The Philistines react to the fact that Samson's wife was given to his friend, which is the direct consequence of the event in 14:20
The thirty men who were given to Samson as companions at the wedding likely included the friend who later received his wife
John the Baptist uses the image of the bridegroom's friend (ὁ φίλος τοῦ νυμφίου), which was an important role at weddings in biblical times, similar to the role Samson's friend had
